question.text: The decreasing order of bond angles in $\mathrm{BF}_3, \mathrm{NH}_3, \mathrm{PF}_3$ and $\mathrm{I}_3^{-}$is :

solution.text:
$\text { B is } s p^2 \text {, Bond angle }=120^{\circ}$
$\mathrm{N} \text { is } s p^3 \text { with } 1 ~l p, \text { Bond angle }=107^{\circ}$
$\mathrm{P} \text { is } s p^3 \text { with } 1 ~l p$ , when central atom size $\uparrow$, bond angle $\downarrow, \quad \therefore \mathrm{NH}_3>\mathrm{PF}_3$
$\mathrm{I}$ is $s p^3 d$ (linear), Bond angle $=180^{\circ}$ $\therefore \quad$ Decreasing order of bond angle $\mathrm{I}_3^{-}>\mathrm{BF}_3>\mathrm{NH}_3>\mathrm{PF}_3$
